headline.purpose: Names the current contribution run and its clearest next state once.

body.purpose: Explains state and consequence without competing with the task.

label.purpose: Names compact actions and visible states without inventing workflow stages.

mono.purpose: Source paths, commits, file names, and diff statistics only.

shadows.name: overlay-only
shadows.purpose: Transient settings and connection overlays only.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The selected item's single meaningful next action.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height:44px; padding:9px 12px; border:1px solid var(--accent); border-radius:10px; background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-fg); font:650 13px var(--font); cursor:pointer; transition:background .14s ease, transform .1s ease; } .ds-primary:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 90%,var(--text)); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-primary:active { transform:scale(.97); }

components.name: Quiet Action
components.description: A compact refresh, back, or secondary action that stays subordinate to content.
components.css: .ds-quiet { min-height:36px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:6px 2px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:transparent; color:var(--muted); font:650 11.5px var(--font); cursor:pointer; } .ds-quiet svg { width:15px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; } .ds-quiet:hover { color:var(--text); } .ds-quiet:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Run Summary
components.description: One calm snapshot of what is ready, moving, and recently accepted, with no workflow rooms to navigate.
components.html:
Current contribution run

3 reviewed changes are ready

3 ready2 moving5 accepted recently
components.css: .ds-run { display:grid; gap:9px; padding:3px 0 18px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); } .ds-run > small { color:var(--muted); font:650 10px var(--font); letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-run h2 { margin:0; color:var(--text); font:700 22px/1.15 var(--font); letter-spacing:-.025em; } .ds-run div { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px 16px; color:var(--muted); font:500 11px var(--font); } .ds-run span { display:inline-flex; align-items:baseline; gap:4px; } .ds-run b { color:var(--text); font-size:12px; }

components.name: Project Row
components.description: A project identity and its next meaningful local-work state.
components.css: .ds-project { width:100%; min-height:68px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:36px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items:center; gap:11px; padding:11px 14px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:15px; background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); text-align:left; } .ds-project-icon { width:36px; height:36px; display:grid; place-items:center; border-radius:10px; background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 11%,var(--surface)); color:var(--accent); font-weight:750; } .ds-project span:nth-child(2) { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px; } .ds-project strong { font:650 12.5px var(--font); } .ds-project small { color:var(--muted); font:400 10.5px var(--font); } .ds-project i { width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--accent); } .ds-project:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 5%,transparent); } .ds-project:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Decision Card
components.description: An airy owner-decision object used only when the current run genuinely needs a choice.
components.css: .ds-request { width:100%; min-height:88px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:38px minmax(0,1fr) 15px; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:14px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:15px; background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); text-align:left; transition:border-color .14s ease,transform .12s ease; } .ds-request-icon { width:38px; height:38px; display:grid; place-items:center; border-radius:11px; background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 12%,transparent); color:var(--accent); } .ds-request span:nth-child(2) { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; min-width:0; } .ds-request small,.ds-request em { overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; color:var(--muted); font:400 10px var(--font); } .ds-request strong { overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; font:650 13px var(--font); } .ds-request:hover { border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 34%,var(--border)); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-request:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview: Contribute feels like a calm collaboration run, not a Git client or an administrative dashboard. One current snapshot gathers related work across projects, keeps private preparation agent-owned, and asks the owner only for exact public decisions. Projects is a secondary lens into that same run; technical detail stays one selection away without competing with the first viewport.
keyCharacteristics: Centered reading canvas with generous negative space.
One decision stream instead of rooms, queues, or workflow stages.
Exact grouped approvals name every public effect before it happens.
Projects refines the same run without creating another owner or hidden scope.
Public and destructive actions remain explicit, truthful, and bound to the reviewed snapshot.

rules.name: Rare Accent
rules.body: Accent identifies current location or the single next decision; it does not decorate every card.

rules.name: One Run
rules.body: Every changed-work item has one visible owner and one place in the current run; filters and project detail refine that snapshot rather than creating competing queues.

rules.name: Flat by Default
rules.body: Persistent content surfaces use borders and tone, not floating trays or ambient dashboard shadows.

dos: Do summarize the current run before offering an exact action.
Do put complete diffs and technical metadata one selection away.
Do keep project and request language understandable without Git terminology.
Do bind every grouped approval to the exact reviewed records and effects.
Do preserve practical touch targets and visible focus states.
donts: Don't make the owner navigate stages or rooms before acting.
Don't duplicate one item across a batch, row action, project action, and focused view.
Don't let filters silently widen an action beyond what is visible.
Don't turn private helper work into another owner-facing queue.
Don't use red for drafts, uncertainty, or caution; reserve it for genuine failure or destruction.
